headline.en: UNI rips +11% on fee-expansion chatter, but price now trades 63% above the DAO's own $5.96 fair-value anchor with net inflation still positive.
headline.zh: UNI 一周上涨 11%,受协议费扩张预期推动,但当前价已高出 DAO 自定的 $5.96 公允价值锚 63%,且净通胀仍为正。

keyChanges.en: Price $9.72, +5.86% 24h / +11.10% 7d, now 63% above the $5.96 treasury burn anchor and at the top of the $4-7 institutional accumulation zone.
Two new Protocol Fee Expansion Temp Checks (Arc, Robinhood Chain) hit the forum — first credible revenue-side catalysts since UNIfication, but neither is on-chain yet.
keyChanges.zh: 论坛新增两项协议费扩张 Temp Check(Arc、Robinhood Chain),UNIfication 后首个实质性收入端催化,但均未进入链上投票。

keyChanges.en: Net supply math still broken: $26.77M annualized buyback burns only 2.75M UNI vs 20M emission, leaving +1.94%/yr net inflation — and higher price makes it worse.
keyChanges.zh: 净供应仍未转正:$26.77M 年化 buyback 仅销毁 2.75M UNI,对冲不了 20M 增发,净通胀 +1.94%/年,价格越高越难通缩。

contrarianObservation.en: Funding is dead flat at +0.01% despite an 11% weekly rip and L/S 1.68 is not extreme — this rally is not crowded, so a Fee Expansion vote actually advancing on-chain could squeeze through $12 before shorts get paid.
contrarianObservation.zh: 尽管周涨 11%,funding(资金费率) 仅 +0.01%,多空比 1.68 也不算极端 —— 多头并不拥挤,一旦 Fee Expansion 真进入链上投票,行情有可能先轧空冲破 $12 再回落。

watchNext.en: Whether Arc and Robinhood Chain Fee Expansion Temp Checks progress to Snapshot/on-chain vote — this is the only near-term lever that can actually flip net-inflation math.
watchNext.zh: 关注 Arc 与 Robinhood Chain 的 Fee Expansion Temp Check 是否推进至 Snapshot/链上投票,这是短期内唯一能扭转净通胀数学的杠杆。

watchNext.en: Absence of any formal real-yield RFC in the top forum threads — until buyback-to-staker redirection is filed, UNI remains a reflexive PE-multiple asset, not a cash-flow asset.
watchNext.zh: 论坛热帖中仍无正式的 real-yield RFC —— 在 buyback 转向 staker 的提案正式提交前,UNI 仍是反身性 PE 估值资产,而非现金流资产。

watchNext.en: Funding rate and OI on Binance perp: if funding pushes >0.03% while OI climbs past $80M, the rally is topping on retail chase.
watchNext.zh: 关注 Binance 永续 funding 与 OI:若 funding 升破 0.03% 且 OI 突破 $80M,说明散户追高、行情见顶信号出现。

fullReasoning.en: The tape looks good and the fundamentals don't. UNI is up 11% on the week into two Protocol Fee Expansion Temp Checks — Arc and Robinhood Chain — which is the correct thing for the market to price, but the market is pricing it before either proposal has even reached Snapshot. At $9.72 the token trades 63% above the $5.96 the DAO itself paid to retire 100M UNI, and sits at the top of the $4-7 institutional zone where smart size accumulated during the 2023-2025 grind. Meanwhile the supply math has not improved — arguably worsened, because a higher price means the fixed $26.77M annual buyback budget retires fewer coins. At spot, burn is 2.75M UNI/yr against 20M emission: still +1.94% net inflation. No real-yield RFC has been filed, so UNI remains a governance/optionality asset priced on narrative multiples, not a cash-flow asset. TVL +6.28% and $157M annualized revenue are respectable but do not justify chasing here. BTC dominance at 58% is a headwind for alt beta. The asymmetric trade over 1-4 weeks is fading strength toward $10-11 and reloading closer to the $5.96 anchor, unless a Fee Expansion actually clears on-chain — in which case the thesis flips.
fullReasoning.zh: 盘面漂亮,基本面不漂亮。UNI 周涨 11%,催化是 Arc 与 Robinhood Chain 两项 Protocol Fee Expansion Temp Check —— 市场理应对其定价,但目前是在两项提案连 Snapshot 都还没进入的阶段抢跑。$9.72 的现价已高出 DAO 自身以 $5.96 回购 100M UNI 的成本 63%,并处于 2023-2025 横盘期间机构建仓的 $4-7 区间上沿。与此同时,供应端数学没有改善,甚至更糟:价格越高,固定的 $26.77M 年度 buyback 预算能回收的代币越少。以现价计,年度销毁 2.75M UNI 对抗 20M 增发,净通胀仍为 +1.94%。real-yield RFC 尚未正式提交,UNI 依旧是按叙事倍数定价的治理/期权资产,而非现金流资产。TVL 周涨 6.28%、年化收入 $157M 数据体面,但不足以支持此位追多。BTC dominance 58% 对山寨 beta 构成压制。1-4 周维度的非对称交易是逢强于 $10-11 减仓,回落至 $5.96 锚附近再介入;唯一反转条件是 Fee Expansion 真正通过链上投票,那时逻辑翻转。
